name: ai-agents-sbx

metadata.description: Sandbox marketplace — the drop point for a candidate under trial. Between trials it holds only sbx-probe; a candidate is added here, tried, then either promoted into a real system or deleted. Switch into it via profile 'sandbox_sm'.

plugins.name: sbx-probe
plugins.description: Sandbox instrumentation: /sbx-check confirms which profile actually loaded and walks the trial checklist. Nothing domain-specific — it exists so a failed trial is distinguishable from a failed switch.

_note: Renamed 2026-08-28 from 'sandbox_sm' to 'ai-agents-sbx'. profiles/sandbox_sm.json registers this directory under the key ai-agents-sbx and enables sbx-probe@ai-agents-sbx, so while the declared name disagreed the plugin could not resolve at all — and switch-profile.sh swallowed the install failure, so the profile reported success with the candidate plugin absent, which is precisely the thing a sandbox exists to make obvious. Every sibling marketplace follows the ai-agents-<short> convention.
